typing.title: Typing trainer
typing.description: Paste your own text or code and practice retyping it with live stats, a timer, and forced correction mode.

hero.subtitle: A local, no-backend practice arena for copying code or text with live feedback.

source.title: Source
source.description: Paste the text you want to practice. You can keep it short or use a full snippet.
source.placeholder: Paste your code or text here...

target.title: Your typing
target.description: Type the source again. Mistakes are highlighted as you go.

controls.forcedCorrectionHelp: When enabled, only characters that keep the text aligned with the source are accepted.
controls.splitViewHelp: Turn this on to separate the preview and the typing area.
controls.lineNumbersHelp: Show or hide line numbers in the preview.

session.title: Session
session.description: Save a source first, then start or stop the typing session.
session.idle: Save the source and press Start to begin.

feedback.forcedCorrection: Keep the text aligned with the source before moving on.
feedback.saveSourceFirst: Save the source first to begin typing.

completion.title: Session complete
completion.description: Nice work. Here are your final stats.

tips.main: Tip: keep the source and your typing side by side for faster corrections.

livePreview.title: Live preview
livePreview.description: Characters are colored by state: correct, incorrect, or current position.
